text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 多题材场景60组 · 41 · 环形空间站的餐叙舱.
Environment:  A spacious empty communal dining compartment following the gentle arc of a rotating space station, warm timber tables, ivory chairs, small prepared tea setting, luminous curved ceiling ribs. Tall windows show the station ring sweeping across a blue-white planet. One comfortable foreground table and a clear passage, bright optimistic civilian life in orbit.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent elevated three-quarter axonometric cutaway / dollhouse image. Remove roof and selected foreground walls to expose the connected spatial volume, floor levels, entrances, furniture and surroundings. Outdoor locations use an elevated terrain model. Clear layered depth, white presentation margin, no inset pictures.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Reconstruct the SAME scene from reference 1 concept plan, reference 2 original look. Match plan footprint, fixed window/door/stair/furniture positions. Scene: 多题材场景60组 · 41 · 环形空间站的餐叙舱. One large roofless axonometric 3D dollhouse cutaway of the entire plan, coherent wall heights, all key furnishings and access visible, white page. For outdoors a raised site massing model. Preserve reference materials, light and style. Unseen extension conservative. Empty environment, NO people, animals, silhouettes, statues of humans, no unrelated spaces. Landscape image, no dimensions.
